mcat_description.short: Warehouse sheds are large prefabricated steel structures designed for industrial storage, logistics, and distribution, supplied as Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB) or conventional steel-frame structures with metal sheet roofing and cladding. They are sold as turnkey construction projects or as supply-and-erect packages, quoted per square foot of built-up area.
mcat_description.long: Warehouse sheds in the Indian market are predominantly Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) systems comprising factory-fabricated steel frames, colour-coated metal sheet roofing, and optional insulated sandwich panel walls, designed and erected to IS 800:2007 and IS 875 standards. They are supplied by manufacturers as end-to-end turnkey solutions covering design, fabrication, transportation, and on-site erection, with clear spans typically ranging from 15 to 150 metres to accommodate material handling equipment and racking systems. The category also includes conventional mild steel truss-based godown sheds (locally called 'tin sheds' or 'patra sheds') using GI or colour-coated sheets, which remain popular for smaller or budget-constrained storage applications. Buyers range from logistics and e-commerce companies requiring large-span distribution centres to SME manufacturers, agro-processors, and traders needing basic covered storage godowns.

market_context: Warehouse sheds in India are dominated by the Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) system, which has become the preferred construction method for warehouses and distribution centres due to faster construction timelines (40–60% faster than conventional RCC), cost efficiency, and design flexibility with clear spans up to 150 metres. Structural steel used in PEB warehouse sheds is governed by IS 800:2007 (Code of Practice for General Construction in Steel) and IS 875 for load design; steel grades IS 2062 and ASTM A36 are the standard structural materials. The Indian market distinguishes between PEB warehouse sheds (factory-fabricated, bolted assembly, portal or rigid frame) and conventional MS truss sheds (site-fabricated, welded, lower cost), with PEB increasingly displacing conventional construction for mid-to-large projects. Roofing options include colour-coated metal sheets (Galvalume, zinc-aluminium coated), insulated sandwich panels (rock wool, glass wool, PUF), and standing seam metal roofs; insulated panels are preferred for temperature-sensitive or food/pharma storage. The term 'godown shed' is the dominant Indian trade vocabulary for warehouse sheds, used interchangeably across buyer segments; 'tin shed' or 'patra shed' (Marathi) refers to basic GI sheet structures popular in smaller or agricultural storage applications. Key Indian PEB manufacturers include EPACK Prefab, Droit Steel Buildings, Metal Tree, AS PEB Solutions, and Pressmach Infrastructure. Buyers typically procure on a turnkey basis (design + supply + erect) and quote requirements in square feet of built-up area.
